page.notes: The catchword at the foot is partly unclear; it reads as "sidem" or "fidem", so I marked it [?]. The line "trem" at the top is a fragment of a word continued from the previous page and is kept as printed. The spelling "qvi", "qvotannis", "tranqvillitatem" and "aliqvod" is printed with qv and is kept. Some letters in the scan are faint, especially in "Clericalis" and "Franciscus", but they are legible.
